A clean finite sample does not prove a population error rate below one percent
All six reviewers share the same Terra-low extraction and saved source context
Latency was measured under up to twelve concurrent CLI calls per stage; phase overlap is reported separately
Latency p95 uses nearest-rank ceil(0.95*n) convention
Judge instructions target at most 2400 visible tokens, while the generic CLI call metadata still says 1800; neither is an enforced provider output ceiling
